# Performance — local vision service (G3.1)

<!-- Generated by `npm run e2e:service` (tests/e2e-service/profile.service.spec.ts). Do not edit by hand. -->

Measured 2026-11-20 on this machine, Chromium with the synthetic board camera (640 × 480 frames), the app on the dev server and the service on 127.0.0.1. Targets from the G3.1 design §9.

| Measure                                                                  |               Result |                 Target |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------: | ---------------------: |
| Frames recognized                                                        | 228 in 45 s (5.1 /s) | 5 /s (200 ms interval) |
| Round trip per frame (request start → response end), median              |                40 ms |                      — |
| Round trip p90                                                           |                47 ms |               ≤ 150 ms |
| Round trip max                                                           |                62 ms |                      — |
| Service processing per frame (decode + warp + recognition), median / p90 |           35 / 41 ms |         ≤ 50 / ≤ 80 ms |
| JPEG payload per frame, median                                           |                21 kB |               ≤ 400 kB |
| Failed frame requests                                                    |                    0 |                      0 |
| Service resident memory, start → end of the run                          |    68.3 MB → 68.7 MB |           flat (±10 %) |

The round trip excludes the JPEG encoding in the remote worker (before the request) and the bitmap decoding after it. Service-side processing per real 1280 × 720 frame is in `docs/vision/service-metrics.md`. One frame is in flight at a time; the frame scheduler drops stale frames.
